correctness.rationale: Seven summands with exponents modulo seven vanish at a primitive seventh root iff their multiplicity polynomial is a multiple of 1+X+...+X^6, hence all multiplicities are one. A collision between x and y in the permutation test for a nonzero delay is equivalent to v=(d(y)-d(x))/(y-x), d(x)=a(x+u)-a(x). Thus the zero count in that row is the number of slopes not attained by secants. Row zero has six zeros and conjugation pairs the opposite delays, giving r=43-2(z1+z2+z3). The independent replay /workspace/replay/septaphase.py enumerates the 7^4 possible x³ through x⁶ coefficients of the unique polynomial representative with a(0)=0. Adding any linear and quadratic terms adds only an affine term to each d, shifting the slope set without changing its size. Each representative therefore has multiplicity 49; this covers all labelled normalized words, without an index-symmetry quotient. The slope-set calculation reproduces the ranks 7,37,39,41,43 with counts 49,14406,18522,24696,59976, all twelve ordered profiles, and all degree strata. At rank seven each row must have exactly one nonzero coefficient; for delay one Fourier inversion makes the phase difference an affine exponent. Summing this difference gives a quadratic exponent, and each quadratic has the claimed profile. For the complex lifting, the conjugation orbit of hh* has distinct characters on the Weyl basis; character projection isolates precisely its nonzero Weyl coefficients, whose absolute values are |A_g(u,v)|/7. The trace pairing is nondegenerate, so the orbit span dimension is the measurement rank. No tolerance, inference to larger p, claim on magnitudes, or nonlinear phase-retrieval assertion is involved.
